description: Buying intent for a list of companies: find which of 2 to 25 domains are hiring hardest. Step 1 (free): send domains and an optional min_intent_score (default 70); every domain gets a hiring-signals check, cold domains come back free with their intent_score, and you get a quote_id. Step 2: send {quote_id} and pay exactly $0.25 USDC per hot company via x402 on Base for a full company profile each (tech stack, hiring intent, Google Ads). At most 4 hot companies per paid call ($1 max); extra hot domains are listed in more_hot to scan again. Zero hot means no charge. Quotes last 15 minutes; 3 free scans per day per IP.

domains.description: Public company domains without a URL scheme, path or port.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

name: find_hot_buyers

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.
